misfits: The computers march on the Throne in the middle, and everyone turns on whoever holds it. You said the Throne and the great lake come back reimagined, with the middle clear until you describe them. Hold these parts until then?
Computers ganging up on a runaway leader needs three or more sides. v100 has two (you and one computer, D122), and more computers are later. Bring it now, waiting for more sides, or hold it?

An A/B test from Nov 3: computers without the free mill and farm, pushing with raids and by holding a choke point instead. You parked replacing the free mill and farm with pressure. v100 has no free mill and farm. Should the pressure become how the computers play, or does the test stay behind?

The computer sells its surplus at the Market for gold when it saves for an age. You cut "surplus sells itself" (Nov 4). Was that only the player's automatic selling, or should the computer not do it either?
The computers see the whole map (no fog), so they know your real strength. Fog for the computers is still parked, not decided. Keep them all-seeing?
